countLiveAndFallback and runStagedCatalogRefresh use the one modelcatalog predicate, not two copies

fix: Add one predicate to internal/modelcatalog (for example Catalog.LiveCount). Use it in countLiveAndFallback (cmd_models.go) and in runStagedCatalogRefresh (cmd_models_live.go). Adopt a pick per family, and only from a live listing. A family whose live listing fails keeps its prior pick and writes the abnormal event catalog_refresh_degraded. A refresh with zero live classifications writes no catalog and does not change FetchedAt, for the live and the shadow catalog. Run the refresh at loop boot, gated by the TTL.
